assets.author: Claude
assets.prompt: Eight 16x16 frames side by side of a grass tuft standing on its foot at the frame's bottom middle: three tufts at rest (thin blades in Leaf shades, dark at the foot, lit tips), two burning (shorter blades in Fire shades, a white-hot Spark tip), one of ash (a low Stone stubble), two trampled (blades lying along the floor). Only non-overlapping rect elements, whole-number coordinates, palette colours from docs/STYLE.md; no outline (floor decoration), light from the top-left.
